name: Ollama
author: joynalbokhsho@gmail.com
description: Run Ollama with local LLM support (Qwen, LLaMA, Gemma, etc). Auto-installs Ollama, starts the API server, and pulls the configured model on boot.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates tar zstd

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "$ARCH" in
    x86_64|amd64) OLLAMA_ARCH="amd64" ;;
    aarch64|arm64) OLLAMA_ARCH="arm64" ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"; exit 1 ;;
esac

echo "=== Disk space available before download ==="
df -h /mnt/server

echo "Downloading Ollama (${OLLAMA_ARCH})..."
DOWNLOAD_OK=0
if curl -fSL --progress-bar -o /mnt/server/ollama.tar.zst "https://ollama.com/download/ollama-linux-${OLLAMA_ARCH}.tar.zst"; then
    DOWNLOAD_OK=1
else
    echo "Primary source failed, trying GitHub releases mirror..."
    if curl -fSL --progress-bar -o /mnt/server/ollama.tar.zst "https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/latest/download/ollama-linux-${OLLAMA_ARCH}.tar.zst"; then
        DOWNLOAD_OK=1
    fi
fi

if [ "$DOWNLOAD_OK" -ne 1 ] || [ ! -s /mnt/server/ollama.tar.zst ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Download failed or file is empty."
    echo "=== Disk space at time of failure ==="
    df -h /mnt/server
    exit 1
fi

echo "Downloaded file size: $(du -h /mnt/server/ollama.tar.zst | cut -f1)"

echo "Extracting..."
mkdir -p /mnt/server/ollama
if ! zstd -d -c /mnt/server/ollama.tar.zst | tar -xf - -C /mnt/server/ollama; then
    echo "ERROR: Extraction failed. The archive is likely incomplete/corrupted."
    echo "This is almost always caused by running out of disk space on this server."
    echo "=== Disk space at time of failure ==="
    df -h /mnt/server
    exit 1
fi
rm -f /mnt/server/ollama.tar.zst

MISSING=0
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/ollama/bin/ollama ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Missing bin/ollama"
    MISSING=1
fi
if [ ! -d /mnt/server/ollama/lib/ollama ] || [ -z "$(ls -A /mnt/server/ollama/lib/ollama 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Missing or empty lib/ollama directory (this holds the inference engine)"
    MISSING=1
fi
if [ "$MISSING" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Ollama installation is incomplete. Aborting."
    echo "=== Disk space at time of failure ==="
    df -h /mnt/server
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x /mnt/server/ollama/bin/ollama
echo "Ollama installed successfully. Total size: $(du -sh /mnt/server/ollama | cut -f1)"

cat <<'EOF' > /mnt/server/start.sh
#!/bin/bash
export PATH="/home/container/ollama/bin:$PATH"
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/container/ollama/lib:/home/container/ollama/lib/ollama:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
export OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:${SERVER_PORT}
export OLLAMA_MODELS=/home/container/models

# Context window size (tokens). Model default is used if left blank.
if [ -n "${CONTEXT_LENGTH}" ]; then
    export OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH="${CONTEXT_LENGTH}"
fi

# How long an idle model stays loaded in memory before unloading (e.g. 5m, 30m, -1 for forever, 0 to unload immediately after each request)
if [ -n "${KEEP_ALIVE}" ]; then
    export OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE="${KEEP_ALIVE}"
fi

# Max number of concurrent requests handled per model
if [ -n "${NUM_PARALLEL}" ]; then
    export OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL="${NUM_PARALLEL}"
fi

# Max number of models kept loaded in memory simultaneously
if [ -n "${MAX_LOADED_MODELS}" ]; then
    export OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS="${MAX_LOADED_MODELS}"
fi

# KV cache quantization: f16 (default, most accurate), q8_0, or q4_0 (less RAM, slight quality loss)
if [ -n "${KV_CACHE_TYPE}" ]; then
    export OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE="${KV_CACHE_TYPE}"
fi

mkdir -p "$OLLAMA_MODELS"

echo "=== Ollama server config ==="
echo "Context length: ${OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH:-model default}"
echo "Keep alive: ${OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE:-5m (default)}"
echo "Num parallel: ${OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL:-1 (default)}"
echo "Max loaded models: ${OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS:-1 (default)}"
echo "KV cache type: ${OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE:-f16 (default)}"
echo "============================"

echo "Starting Ollama server on port ${SERVER_PORT}..."
/home/container/ollama/bin/ollama serve &
SERVE_PID=$!

until curl -s http://127.0.0.1:${SERVER_PORT}/api/tags > /dev/null 2>&1; do
    sleep 1
done

echo "Pulling model: ${MODEL_NAME}"
/home/container/ollama/bin/ollama pull "${MODEL_NAME}" || echo "Model pull failed, server will still run"

echo "Listening on ${SERVER_PORT}"
wait $SERVE_PID

EOF

chmod +x /mnt/server/start.sh
echo "Installation complete."

variables.name: Model Name
variables.description: The Ollama model to automatically pull and run on startup (e.g. qwen2.5:3b, llama3.1:8b, gemma2:9b).

variables.name: Context Length
variables.description: Max context window in tokens (prompt + response combined). Leave blank for model default (usually 4096-8192). Larger values need more RAM. Try 16384 or 32768 for long code generation.

variables.name: Keep Alive
variables.description: How long the model stays loaded in memory after the last request before unloading (e.g. 5m, 30m, 1h). Use -1 to never unload, 0 to unload immediately after each request. Leave blank for Ollama's default (5m).

variables.name: Num Parallel
variables.description: Max number of requests processed concurrently per model. Higher values need proportionally more RAM for context. Leave blank for Ollama's default (usually 1).

variables.name: Max Loaded Models
variables.description: Max number of different models Ollama keeps in memory at once. Leave blank for Ollama's default (usually 1). Only raise this if you plan to switch between multiple models without unloading.

variables.name: KV Cache Type
variables.description: Quantization for the KV cache. f16 = default, most accurate. q8_0 = ~half the RAM, tiny quality loss. q4_0 = least RAM, more noticeable quality loss. Leave blank for f16.
